avis.texte: I bought this at TJ MAX, with the toner on clearance, I didn’t even know what I was buying because the writing is in Korean, but I came home and I googled it, and it is one of the best moisturizers I’ve used. So I bought the whole set for my sister here on Amazon.

The best product ever!!! Works so good. My face feels so smooth shiny and health. so I started to be lazy and stop use another stuff. If you don't have time or lazy whatever.... you can have just this one magic bottle and it will be eunath. I tried so many different stuff but this is one love ❤️

avis.titre: Great part of a skincare routine
avis.texte: This is a huge container of emulsion. I really love the value on this, plus the pump bottle is convenient. The product itself is vegan, made carefully and comes from a Korean company where you know they take beauty care seriously. I use this emulsion after toner and any serums I am using in the evening. After applying and letting this absorb, my skin feels lush and firm with no sticky or greasy residue. This is almost like a milky water that soaks right into your skin. I follow up with a typical night moisturizer and in the morning I wake up with soft and supple skin. This is a good product to add to your routine for any skin type!

avis.titre: Good to use during cold, dry winter months 👍⭐️Good to use during cold, dry winter months 👍⭐️
avis.texte: MY ⭐️RATINGS: 4⭐️- I would recommend it as the one to get. This helps strengthen my skin barrier during the winter months. The cold, dry air does a lot more damage to my skin as I get older. Using this emulsion soothes my skin and keeps it hydrated. It is lightweight and absorbs quickly. I always dry my face & hands thoroughly before applying any serums or emulsions. Then, I ensure the serum or emulsion absorbs into my skin before applying moisturizer. If I don’t, I get a sticky, icky feel. I find if I want results, I must be consistent and patient. Missing applications slow the benefits of the product on my skin. HOW I USE: AM & PM 1 - Cleanse my face, 2 - I apply 1 pump of this Emulsion on my face. 3 - LAST, I finish with my usual moisturizer. COSNORI Panthenol Barrier Emulsion works well with the other skincare products that are part of my facial regimen. EXPIRATION DATE: 01/24/2027 I always check for an expiration date before using, ESPECIALLY with health & beauty products. This Emulsion isas advertised, and works well. The PRICE is in the usual range.

avis.titre: Lightweight & effective in warm temps!Lightweight & effective in warm temps!
avis.texte: I've been using this Cosnori emulsion for the past month or so and it's pretty decent quality. The lightweight emulsion is perfect for my combination skin, as it provides the right amount of hydration without feeling overly greasy. The emulsion texture is silky and it absorbs quickly, which is great for my busy mornings when I'm rushing to get ready. It layers well under my moisturizer, sunscreen and makeup, and it leaves my skin feeling smooth and well-moisturized throughout the day. The subtle, pleasant scent is a nice bonus, adding to the overall experience without being too powerful or overwhelming. One of the benefits I've noticed after using this product is an improvement in my skin's elasticity and texture. My face feels firmer and more supple with a noticeable reduction in dry patches, and the formula seems to enhance my skin's natural glow. The reason I'm not giving this emulsion five stars is that it will be a bit too light for daily use during colder months when my skin needs extra (heavier) hydration. I will need to layer it with a heavier moisturizer in winter, but it's perfect and light for spring and summer use! Overall, this emulsion is effective, gentle, and it leaves my skin looking and feeling great. I would recommend giving it a try if you're looking for a reliable, everyday emulsion moisturizer for use underneath your regular moisturizer and/or sunscreen in warm temps!

This is a very large pump bottle (5oz) of Panthenol lotion. It goes on silky smooth and has a creamy feel and texture. The ingredients on the packaging are in a different language but on the Amazon listing it states that this product contains several beneficial compounds including: kakadu plum, squalene, hyaluronic acid, adenosine, niacinamide. The kakadu plum is very high in vitamin C. This is an all around great moisturizer for the face, hands and even the rest of the body. The pump works great and I have not had any issues with it. There is no fragrance that I can detect, so it is likely safe for sensitive skin types. I applied it to my face and hands thus far and both have felt very soft and hydrated. I like simple, clean products like this and I definitely recommend this!

I love emulsions because they are like an extra layer of hydration. I like to sandwich them between my serum and moisturizer for extra dewy skin. This emulsion is vegan and contains panthenol, aka Vitamin B5, along with Kakadu plum extract. These ingredients work together to help strengthen the skin and help it recover. The texture is very lightweight and the emulsion is unscented. I use this product both morning and evening in my skincare routine and have noticed that my skin feels softer and stays hydrated all day. This emulsion is very gentle with no harsh ingredients and can be used by all skin types.

I recently received this very hydrating emulsion and my dry skin loves it! It arrived well-boxed and secure, it's vegan making it wonderful for the environment, and contains niacinamide which my skin adoress along with other hydration ingredients. I wish the company would have written their instructions in English on the box/bottle since they're selling it here at Amazon and many of us speak and read only English, all in all, though this is a very good hydrating product and many of us can figure out how and when to use it on our skin. I recommend this product to those who like myself need the added hydration, fragrance-free too.
